theme: a mariners' chapel inside a tidal cathedral: boats, sails, ropes and votive offerings

tiles.prompt: weathered wooden boat hull planks painted faded teal blue, horizontal clinker planks with chipped paint revealing grey wood, copper rivets
knotted brown fishing net laid flat over a dark tarred wooden surface, diamond mesh pattern
old cream sailcloth canvas with visible weave, a few darker rectangular patches stitched on, faint salt stains
sun-bleached silver-grey driftwood surface with deep wavy grain, cracks and a few small barnacles

an antique hand-drawn nautical chart on aged parchment filling the whole panel: a rocky island coastline, a compass rose, rhumb lines, depth soundings in tiny numerals, sepia ink with faded blue sea wash
an engraved brass ship's compass card seen straight from above, centred, filling the panel: ornate 32-point compass rose, fleur-de-lis north, degree ring, warm polished brass with dark engraved lines
heavily rusted wrought iron surface of an old anchor, flaking orange-brown rust, pitted dark metal, salt crust
iridescent abalone and mother-of-pearl shell inlay, swirling pastel blue, green, pink and silver sheen
tightly coiled thick hemp rope seen from above, dark tarred brown, twisted three-strand fibres, coils filling the panel
